blocks.text: Abbotsford Homes Under $1.8M: streets and boundaries

items.t: This page is a price band, not a neighbourhood: the $1.8 million ceiling is a listing-feed filter over the whole City of Abbotsford, not a City, board or planning designation, and no street bounds it.

blocks.text: Abbotsford Homes Under $1.8M: the housing stock

items.t: No official source profiles the stock inside this price band: what the band holds is decided lot by lot by Abbotsford's zones, not by the ceiling itself, and the band's era, lot-size and suite-frequency profile is not verified as a measured profile.

Suites are a structural part of this segment, not an add-on: the City requires secondary suites to be registered with the City, and its guides treat suites, coach houses and garden suites as standard accessory forms across the urban zones where most of this band sits.

blocks.text: Abbotsford Homes Under $1.8M: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Abbotsford's small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) amendment is Bylaw No. 3560-2024, "Abbotsford Zoning Bylaw, 2014, No. 2400, Amendment Bylaw, 2024, No. 3560," adopted June 25, 2024: accessory units count toward a lot's total permitted units — up to 4 units on one lot in SSMUH areas, being 3 units on lots 280 square metres or less and 4 units on lots bigger than 280 square metres.

A secondary suite is a dwelling unit accessory to, and within, a principal dwelling unit, part of the same real estate entity; suites must be registered with the City, and the size cap is now less than 50 percent of the size of the principal unit.

Subdivision on the farm edge is effectively closed at this band's scale: the City's AgRefresh parcel-size work records a minimum subdivision lot area of 8.0 hectares in the Agricultural One Zone (A1) and 16.0 hectares in the Agricultural Two Zone (A2).

blocks.text: Abbotsford Homes Under $1.8M: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Abbotsford Regional Hospital and Cancer Centre at 32900 Marshall Road provides emergency, surgery and maternity care, open 24 hours, and the Abbotsford Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 100-2692 Clearbrook Road provides urgent care 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. seven days a week — both Fraser Health services serving the whole band.

The suite size cap changed: it is now less than 50 percent of the principal unit, changed in most zones from a 100 square metre cap — so an older suite sized under the old rule is not proof a new one of the same size is permitted.
A price band has no census geography, so there is no official population or income profile for "under $1.8M" buyers: not verified — nothing is substituted.

blocks.text: Abbotsford Homes Under $1.8M: costs and taxes

items.t: Property transfer tax inside this band uses only two tiers: 1 percent on the first $200,000 of fair market value and 2 percent on the portion above $200,000 — the 3 percent tier starts only above $2,000,000, outside this band.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax applies in Abbotsford, a listed taxable area on the Province's page.

blocks.text: Abbotsford Homes Under $1.8M: risks and due diligence

items.t: Run the Agricultural Land Reserve check before valuing any second dwelling on the band's rural edge: the Agricultural Land Commission caps the principal residence at 500 square metres with a 1,000 square metre fill limit, and local government bylaws may further restrict residences.

Verify every marketed suite against the current bylaw and the City's registration requirement, not the listing sheet: the cap is now less than 50 percent of the principal unit, and listing-text suite claims are feed text, not permit verification.
Do not price subdivision potential into an A1 or A2 acreage in this band: subdivision minimums are 8.0 hectares (A1) and 16.0 hectares (A2) in the City's parcel-size work — older than 12 months.

faq.a: No sourced number exists, and any figure quoted for the band should be treated as not verified.
faq.q: How many Abbotsford homes are actually for sale under $1.8M?

faq.a: No. The Province's general rates are 1 percent on the first $200,000 of fair market value, 2 percent on the portion above $200,000 up to and including $2,000,000, and 3 percent only on the portion above $2,000,000, with a further 2 percent on the residential portion of value above $3,000,000 — so a purchase under $1,800,000 meets only the first two tiers.
faq.q: Does a purchase under $1.8M reach the top property transfer tax tier?

faq.a: No — legality is a City-records question, not a listing-text question. A secondary suite must sit within the principal unit, be part of the same real estate entity, be registered with the City, and be less than 50 percent of the principal unit's size, so a marketed "mortgage helper" still needs its registration and permit history checked.
faq.q: Is a suite in an Abbotsford house in this band automatically legal?

faq.a: Only within tight Agricultural Land Commission limits. A suite is permitted only inside the principal residence, one additional residence is capped at 90 square metres on properties of 40 hectares or less or 186 square metres over 40 hectares, and City zoning also applies, with A1 subdivision minimums of 8.0 hectares and A2 at 16.0 hectares.
faq.q: Can a farm-edge property in this band add a second house?

faq.a: A secondary suite must be within the principal unit, registered with the City, and less than 50% of the principal unit's size; a coach house or garden suite may occupy up to 15% of the lot to a maximum of 100 m²; and under the SSMUH amendment (Bylaw No. 3560-2024, adopted June 25, 2024) accessory units count toward up to 4 units on one lot in SSMUH areas — 3 units on lots 280 m² or less, 4 on larger lots.
faq.q: Can an Abbotsford house under $1.8M have a suite, a coach house or added units?

faq.a: Under the ALC's housing guidance, a principal residence is capped at 500 m² total floor area with a 1,000 m² fill limit, a secondary suite is permitted only inside the principal residence, and one additional residence is permitted up to 90 m² on properties of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on properties over 40 ha; City zoning (A1 subdivision minimum 8.0 ha; A2 16.0 ha) also applies.
